description: Paginated list of policy sets: named collections of violation rules (tag / IAB V3 / brand / AI category / custom-taxonomy entries) that define what counts as a violation. Campaigns bind to one policy set. Returns `{items, total, page, limit}`. List items omit `entries` for payload size — fetch a single set via `get_policy_set` when you need them. `is_default` is true on the owned set that new campaigns bind when `policy_set_id` is omitted. Use `visibility=public` to discover Kaminari Ad-curated sets.

visibility.description: Narrow to one scope. `private` = org-owned only, `public` = Kaminari Ad-curated sets visible to every org. Omit the filter to see BOTH combined.

name: list_policy_sets
title: List Policy Sets
